prs.title: docs: point the READMEs at the published 0.31.0 packages
prs.body:
Moves the install pins from 0.30.0 to 0.31.0: the Android and Java Maven coordinates, the Swift package's `from:`, the Python wheel build example, and the service image tags in the Docker README.

The browser row now links the `offline-protocol-web` crate, which 0.31.0 published to crates.io. It still says the JavaScript package is not published.

The Ruby row is unchanged. The `publish-rubygems` job in the 0.31.0 release failed, and the gem is not on RubyGems yet.

**Merge only after both of these serve 0.31.0:**
- The Swift package. `publish.yml` in `offline-protocol-swift` has not run for 0.31.0 yet.
- Maven Central. Both artifacts reached the Portal, but `repo1.maven.org` still returned 404 at the time of writing, which is the usual sync lag.

prs.title: chore(release): 0.31.0
prs.body:
The version half of the 0.31.0 cut. The documentation half merged as #640. Tagging `v0.31.0` on this merge publishes the release.

## Version files

- `Cargo.toml`: the workspace version and the eleven internal dependency versions.
- The five local internal dependency versions in `offline-protocol-sealed`, `offline-protocol-leaf` and `offline-protocol-web`.
- `Cargo.lock`, `tools/embedded-footprint/Cargo.lock` and `tools/mls-interop/Cargo.lock`. The diffs change version lines only, apart from `crypto-bigint` (below).
- `bindings/python/pyproject.toml`, `bindings/react-native/package.json` with its lockfile, and `bindings/flutter/offline_protocol/pubspec.yaml`.
- `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md` ×3, regenerated. Versions are the only change.

No other tracked file carries 0.30.0 as a version. The remaining `0.30.0` strings are install pins in the READMEs and the Docker README, which move after publish.

## `crypto-bigint` 0.7.6 → 0.7.10

Upstream yanked 0.7.6, 0.7.7 and 0.7.8 because 0.7.9 fixed a wrong blanket `Mul` impl for `NonZero<T>`, an API break. The RUSTSEC-2026-0387 timing fix is in all of them. A yanked version is never chosen in a fresh resolution. Users of the published crates would therefore build against 0.7.10 while CI tested 0.7.6, so the lockfile now pins 0.7.10. `ctutils` moves from 0.4.5 to 0.4.6 with it. Both declare Rust 1.87, the workspace minimum.

The CHANGELOG security entry, `deny.toml` and `.cargo/audit.toml` now name 0.7.10 where they said the workspace runs on 0.7.6. "Below 0.7.6" stays, because that is the advisory's range.

## `cargo audit` waivers

RUSTSEC-2026-0330 and RUSTSEC-2026-0331 report panics in `libcrux-kem` 0.0.7 on a short hybrid key or seed. The crate is in `Cargo.lock` only under `hpke-rs-libcrux`, the HPKE backend the waiver file already documents as never compiled. `cargo tree --workspace --target all -i libcrux-kem` prints nothing. Both are added to that group in `.cargo/audit.toml`. `deny.toml` needs nothing, because cargo-deny never sees a lockfile-only crate.

`cargo audit` now finds no vulnerabilities.

## Verification

- `cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings` is clean.
- `cargo test --workspace --no-fail-fast` ran all 34 targets: 3600 passed, 4 ignored, 1 failed. The failure is `no_shipped_file_names_a_relay`, which walks the checkout and found relay URLs only inside gitignored agent worktrees under `.claude/worktrees` on the machine that ran it. A clean checkout has none, and nothing in this diff names a relay.
- The Nostr cryptography on `crypto-bigint` 0.7.10 passes the official NIP-44 vectors and the golden values for routing tags, discovery tags and record seal keys.
- `cargo audit` reports no vulnerabilities. `cargo deny check advisories` is ok.
- Every lockfile and notices diff changes version lines only, apart from the two crates named above.

## Before the tag

- A `workflow_dispatch` dry run of `release.yml` from this branch with `version: 0.31.0` and `dry_run: true`.
- `offline-protocol-web` is new on crates.io. It is the only new crate, so the release spends one unit of the new-crate budget, inside the burst of five. Reserving it first is not required.
- The RubyGems trusted publisher must exist on rubygems.org. It needs no GitHub environment.

prs.title: docs: match the documentation to the 0.31.0 release
prs.body:
The documentation half of the 0.31.0 cut, covering `v0.30.0..e07b88be` (38 commits). It touches no code and no version files.

## Release notes

- `CHANGELOG.md`: `[Unreleased]` becomes `[0.31.0] — 2026-10-27` (fix the date if the merge slips). Changes to the section:
  - A release header.
  - Headings in the 0.30.0 order: Security, Added, Changed, Fixed.
  - The browser work first.
  - The one inline issue link dropped.
- The Flutter entry now says that `start()` on Android runs the mesh foreground service. It is new to the plugin in this range, and the manifest merges three permissions and a `connectedDevice` service.
- The cold-contact entry said "every binding". It now says "from a phone too": Python, Java, Ruby and C have no Nostr driver.
- 0.30.0 is archived to `docs/changelog/0.30.md`, with rows added to both archive tables. It matches the section as tagged at `v0.30.0` except the three `docs/` links, which are rewritten to `../`.
- `docs/UPGRADING.md`:
  - The current line is now `v0.31.x`.
  - "nine releases can break a build" becomes ten.
  - A new §29 covers what breaks at compile time and what changes at run time.

### What breaks a build (checked against the diff)

- `Event::PeerRssi`. `Event` is not `#[non_exhaustive]`.
- `ephemeral` on `SendMessageOptions` and `GroupSendOptions`. Code that uses `..Default::default()` is fine.
- `KeyPackagePayload.no_session` in `offline-protocol-sealed`. It has no `Default`, so struct literals break; the leaf had to add the field itself.
- The TypeScript `ProtocolEvent` union gains `PeerRssiEvent`.
- Flutter now exports `MeshSdk`.
- No public item is removed or renamed, and there are no MSRV or toolchain changes.

## Stale documentation fixed

- **ADR 0032 and `docs/bridges/web.md`** said a rung that can never decrypt is never acknowledged and "that is not built". #631 built it. The ADR status line is amended in the ADR 0024 style.
- **`docs/state-machines/group-message-lifecycle.md`**: the receive diagram gains the `Spent` arm. A frame from a member is acknowledged; anyone else's is buffered unanswered.
- **`docs/security/threat-model.md`, network egress**: the browser now opens Nostr transport sockets from the worker (W12), plus relay and STUN traffic for `NearbyRoom` (R30). Web Bluetooth opens nothing.
- **`docs/telemetry.md`**: only sends that ask for an acknowledgement count toward `sends_attempted_sum`.
- **`crates/offline-protocol-web/README.md`**: this becomes the crates.io page. It now puts the relay sockets and `BroadcastChannel` in the worker, and WebRTC and Bluetooth on the page.
- **`CONTRIBUTING.md`**:
  - The browser crate is the third crate with a locally declared internal dependency version.
  - The channel list names `offline-protocol-java` and RubyGems.
- **`SECURITY.md`**: the supported line is now `0.31.x`, and the "one number covers every channel" sentence names every channel.
- **`docs/README.md`**:
  - 34 ADRs (it said twenty-eight) and 14 bridge rules (it said thirteen).
  - Rows for the Flutter, Web and two-device web contracts.
  - Rows for the two browser examples.
- **Generated-binding docs**: five languages, not three (`android-integration`, `ios-integration`, `api-reference`, the example `SETUP.md`). `peer_rssi` is added to the React Native event list.
- **`README.md`**: the browser row now names Chromium, Firefox and Safari, all of which CI runs.
- **One broken anchor**: `web.md` pointed at `#c7-ordering-constraints`.

## Verification

- A link and anchor check over all 183 tracked `.md` files finds nothing broken. Its three remaining hits are example text inside backticks or a regex.
- `scripts/check-crate-readmes.sh` and `scripts/check-license-consistency.sh` pass.
- No Rust guard reads any sentence this PR changes. I checked with a grep of `*.rs`, `*.py` and `*.sh` for each edited file.
- No em dashes in added prose. The only one is in the CHANGELOG release heading, which follows the existing convention.

## Still owed before the tag (not in this PR)

- **Version files**:
  - `Cargo.toml`, plus the local internal dependencies in sealed, leaf and web.
  - `Cargo.lock` and the two tool lockfiles.
  - `pyproject.toml`, `package.json`/`package-lock.json` and `pubspec.yaml`.
  - `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md` ×3.
- **Reserve `offline-protocol-web` on crates.io.** The sparse index returns 404, and release.yml publishes it last.
- **Create the `rubygems` environment on this repository.** `RUBYGEMS_PUBLISH` is set, but only the `pypi` environment exists, and the pending trusted publisher must name it.
- **Silence two `cargo audit` advisories.** `cargo audit` flags RUSTSEC-2026-0330 and 0331 (`libcrux-kem` 0.0.7). It is lockfile-only and `cargo deny` passes, but `.cargo/audit.toml` should waive both beside the other libcrux entries.
- **Run a `workflow_dispatch` dry run with `version: 0.31.0`.** The run on 2026-10-26 had no version input and stopped at the npm `0.0.0-dev` gate, after every build and test job had passed.
- **After publish:** re-point the README and Docker README package pins from `0.30.0`, and update the RubyGems and crates.io "not published yet" wording.
